purpose: Pre-registered replication, in an outcome cohort never opened by this program, of the association tested (and not passed) in lmna-acute-lamina-vs-chronic-compartment-2026-09-24: 500 kb regions whose LMNB1 association rises most after acute LMNA depletion (GSE300197) shift toward compartment B under chronic LMNA loss.

hypothesis.direction: negative Spearman correlation between dlam_mCh (siLMNA - siScr LMNB1 z-score, per hg19 500 kb tile) and dPC1 = mean(KO PC1) - mean(WT PC1) in GSE314556
hypothesis.primary_statistic: rank-partial Spearman adjusted for baseline PC1 (mean WT) and baseline lamina (siScr_mCh)
hypothesis.claim_ceiling: computational association across two independent public studies of different lineage and perturbation class; no mechanism; no wet-lab confirmation

predictor.source: GSE300197 condition-merged LMNB1 CUT&RUN z-score bigWigs (hg38), lifted to hg19

outcome.cell: GM12878 B-lymphoblastoid; LMNA/C CRISPR-KO transduced pool vs control-sgRNA pool (labelled WT by the depositors)

pc1_pipeline.method: HiC-Pro allValidPairs or 4DN-style pairs (layout auto-detected from the first data line, recorded in stats) -> cis autosomal (chr1-22) 500 kb count matrices (bin=(pos-1)//500000, symmetric) -> ICE (Imakaev; W <- W/(s s^T), s = rowsum/mean(rowsum); stop at max|s-1|<1e-5 or 200 iterations; bins masked if raw row has <10 nonzeros or zero row sum, mask enlarged iteratively; zero-variance O/E columns masked) -> observed/expected (each diagonal divided by its mean over unmasked pairs; zero-expected diagonals set to 1) -> Pearson correlation of the unmasked submatrix -> numpy eigh leading eigenvector, unit variance, provisional sign sum>=0 -> per-chromosome flip so Spearman with hg19 RefSeq Select TSS count per bin is positive; chromosomes with |rho|<0.2 or <3 usable bins emitted all-NaN. Masked bins omitted from the bedGraph. The evaluator (compartment.orient_tracks) re-applies its own orientation and exclusion rule on the WT mean.
pc1_pipeline.runtime_expectation: ~0.5 M lines/s single core; ~4-6 min per 2 GB gz; flat ~200 MB RSS

method_validation.dataset: GSE126459 valid pairs GSM3602092 (mutant rep1) and GSM3602088 (corrected.1 rep1), hg38, already observed in the compartment campaign
method_validation.status: passed 2026-09-24T21:02:48Z (attempt 3, bound script): V1 0.9225/0.8804, V2 0.5471, n 5,262; every attempt retained in design/method-validation-attempts.md; no threshold of this registration depends on it
method_validation.script: design/validate_pc1.py (bound at freeze; deposited-PC1 directory passed as an argument)

null.type: within-chromosome circular shift of the predictor block

evaluator.frozen_dependency: code/compartment.py (byte-identical to the compartment campaign freeze-002, sha256 776ccedec155bfe2c45ed0a8092b38f6c7558c585fdcf8366f1d6be643fd4019)
evaluator.adapter: KO samples take the 'mutant' role and WT the single corrected line; tier_a thresholds are copied into the v2 pass_criteria keys by replicate.adapter_registration

pass_criteria.rule: conjunctive; every component below must hold

tier_a.name: direction replicates with a non-trivial effect
tier_a.replicate_pairs: all four KO-WT pairwise Spearman correlations negative

tier_b.name: effect size comparable to the cardiomyocyte cohort
tier_b.anchoring: -0.10 equals the prior campaign's unadjusted floor and lies in its observed adjusted range (-0.150/-0.112); it is an effect-size replication claim, not a discovery threshold; only tier B makes the adjusted statistic operative beyond tier A's -0.05

verdict_labels.mechanical: replicate.verdict; labels are exactly the keys of interpretation_precommitted
verdict_labels.NOT_PASSED_DIRECTION_CONSISTENT: orientation ok, and unadjusted, adjusted and standardised-unadjusted rho all < 0 with p <= p_max, and all four replicate pairs negative, but at least one effect floor, the ratio criterion or the tile minimum fails
verdict_labels.no_spin_rule: a NOT_PASSED* result is reported as 'not passed' in the first sentence of every summary; direction-consistency may be stated only after that sentence and only with the sub-label's definition

confound_flags.statistic: mean over oriented chromosomes of eigenvalue/(n unmasked bins) of the O/E Pearson matrix (PC1 variance share), KO mean over WT mean; invariant to the per-chromosome unit scaling of the eigenvector
confound_flags.sd_ratio_note: the evaluator's SD ratio is reported only as a replicate-concordance diagnostic; it cannot measure compartment strength because pc1.py scales each chromosome's eigenvector to unit variance
confound_flags.note: reported only; if flagged the claim ceiling adds 'global compartment-strength change present'; KO rep2 depth (~half) disclosed regardless

operating_characteristics.note: conjunctive rule over three correlated arms and four pairs is below the single-arm figure

full_rule_simulation_by_reviewer.source: design/independent-review.json round_1 (reviewer's scratch simulation on the real hg19 predictor with unit-scaled synthetic PC1, noisier KO rep2, 299 shifts, 12 seeds per level)

secondary_reported_only: baseline PC1 vs baseline lamina rho
per-replicate PC1 orientation and cis-pair counts

per-chromosome table pairing the method-validation agreement with the deposited GSE126459 PC1 (design/method-validation.json per_chromosome_spearman; chr22 ~0.21, chr4 0.40 in one sample, chr21 absent from the deposited track) with the per-chromosome outcome correlation from results/run-001/core (the evaluator's per-chromosome output); compiled at report time by joining those two mechanically produced records, not by replicate.py; no threshold depends on it

interpretation_precommitted.TIER_B_PASS: association generalises across lineage and perturbation class with effect size in the cardiomyocyte range; computational association only
interpretation_precommitted.TIER_A_PASS: association generalises across lineage and perturbation class; effect smaller than in cardiomyocytes or below the tier-B floor
interpretation_precommitted.NOT_PASSED_DIRECTION_CONSISTENT: not passed; direction consistent with the hypothesis in every arm but the effect is below the registered floor; no threshold change; not evidence of generalisation
interpretation_precommitted.NOT_PASSED: not passed; no evidence of generalisation to this lineage; ambiguous between refutation and cardiac specificity
interpretation_precommitted.PIPELINE_FAILURE: outcome PC1 did not meet the pre-stated quality rule in more than 3 autosomes; no claim in either direction; repair only in a new registration

prior_art.class_known: LAD-compartment coupling (Zheng 2018 mESC; Bertero 2019 restricted compartment change); GSE314556 preprint reports 39 B->A and 23 A->B switches and global loop loss, no lamin B1 genomic data

policy.no_contact: unsent material only; no attribution of endorsement

pipeline_qc.rule: per chromosome and sample: pc1.py orientation must succeed and Spearman(sample PC1, WT-reference PC1) >= 0.5 over finite tiles, where the WT reference is the mean of the WT samples other than the sample itself (leave-one-out for WT samples; KO samples use the full WT mean); otherwise the chromosome is excluded genome-wide (recorded with reason). More than 3 excluded autosomes = PIPELINE_FAILURE (statistics still computed and reported; not a pass, not a refutation).
pipeline_qc.exclusion_cap_scope: max_excluded_autosomes counts only chromosomes dropped by this pipeline QC (unoriented in pc1.py, too few tiles, or concordance < 0.5). Chromosomes the evaluator (compartment.orient_tracks) later drops by its own orientation rule on the WT mean are reported separately and do not count toward the cap.
